# Purpose

Award credit for a correct torque load path, constant internal torque, variable polar moment, dimensionally consistent radius function, correct twist integration, stress localization, stiffness interpretation, and a bounded engineering recommendation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes a solid circular shaft, homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic material, Saint-Venant torsion, small rotation, shaft-axis torque, constant shear modulus, continuously varying radius, and a rigid rotational restraint. Bending, axial loading, local shoulder stress concentrations, bearing flexibility, fatigue, warping, dynamics, and manufacturing details are excluded.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- internal torque and variable section formulation: 25%;
- numerical twist and stress evaluation: 35%;
- stiffness interpretation and recommendation: 20%.
